Revised prompt:

Create an extreme close-up macro portrait photograph of a young woman's face during the golden hour of the late afternoon. Position the subject so that warm, natural side lighting from a low-angle sun illuminates her face, creating a soft, glowing effect on her dewy, freckled skin. Ensure the right eye is the primary focus, with the iris in sharp focus and the pupil reflecting the warm sunlight with high clarity and depth.

Compose the shot with a very shallow depth of field, isolating only the key facial features of the eye, nose, and lips, while allowing the background to blur into a creamy, out-of-focus abstraction. The skin should be rendered with hyper-realistic detail, showcasing every nuance of texture - visible pores, freckles, and subtle imperfections. Avoid heavy post-processing retouching; the skin should appear natural and authentic.

The color palette should be dominated by warm, earthy tones: rich bronze, tan, gold, and soft browns. These colors should be allowed to interact with the skin tones and highlights, creating a natural, sun-kissed look. The overall mood of the image should be intimate, calm, and evocative of the warmth and tranquility of the late afternoon light.

The lighting should be designed to mimic the quality of natural, golden-hour sunlight, with soft, diffused highlights and gentle, long shadows. The composition should follow the cinematic beauty photography style, with a focus on storytelling through the details of the subject's face and the emotional impact of the lighting and color.

Please provide the image as a high-resolution JPG file with a minimum size of 5000 x 7500 pixels, optimized for print or high-end digital display. Include the RAW file as a bonus to allow for further adjustments.
